verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of an external agent acting on Shortwave email is a changelog note about a Tasklet integration that takes action on emails and places drafts in Shortwave. A trigger-based feature that drafts replies and connects to other apps is also mentioned. Shortwave's MCP support is client-side only: its own assistant connects out to other servers, which does not let Claude, ChatGPT or a custom agent connect in. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: a documented public API or first-party MCP server for arbitrary external agents, documented read/triage/send operations for external agents, setup docs for Claude/ChatGPT, and independent hands-on corroboration.
